decision_improved: Comparar AIOX Research, como referência interna SINKRA/Squad Research, contra 24 players externos de deep research para decidir padrões de absorção, gaps e adapters prioritários.

taxonomy.player_model: AIOX Research internal reference plus externally cloned/evaluated open-source deep-research players
taxonomy.dimension_source: 130 feature-specific microdimensions derived from bench-output-dash.json, local clone scans in ../bench, inventories, scorecard, code-anatomist outputs and expanded agentic/provider/research-depth analysis.

scoring_model.formula: Sum(score_microdimension × row.weight) / Sum(row.weight), excluding zero-weight self-reference rows.
scoring_model.scale: 0 means absent/non-operational; 50 means partial/default/uncertain; 70-84 strong; 85-100 reference capability for that microdimension.
scoring_model.weight_policy: Weights prioritize Agentic Planning Control, Tool Runtime Integration, Research Depth Synthesis, Multi-Agent Orchestration, Evidence Fidelity Evaluation and UX Operator Control. Sinkra Fit has weight 0 to avoid anchor self-reference inflating weighted totals.
scoring_model.normalization: All player scores are normalized to 0-100. Missing or weak evidence is low-confidence and should not be interpreted as execution proof without source/replay.
scoring_model.tie_break_policy: Prefer stronger local evidence, replayability, implementation depth, source/provider breadth, factual verification and operator control; keep ties explicit when weighted gaps are small.
